posts.caption: Want to join Penn’s only undergraduate medical humanities journal, Word for Word? Applications are OPEN up until 09/06, 11:59 pm EST!! Apply to be an interviewer, columnist, editor, or media designer, and explore other opportunities for community service and leadership through our organization. Application link is in our linktree, apply today! 🤍✍️

Preceptorial Tomorrow! 🔊 Artists, aspiring premed students, writers, and anyone curious about the medical humanities: come join us! 🩺🎨✍️

Word for Word is Penn’s undergraduate medical humanities journal, bringing together medicine, the humanities, and art to explore the human experiences behind health and healing. Beyond the page, we knit word with action through immersive outreach and service opportunities.

Come  hear some premed advice, learn about our journal, get tips for applying to join the team, and discover opportunities to connect medicine, writing, art, and service within a warm and supportive community.

11am-12pm 
Saturday, August 22, 2026
Williams Hall 29

Friday 4/24 @ chairs outside Harnwell 1-5 pm!

Extra dinning dollars/meal swipes left over? Moving out? We would love your help in donating individually packaged snacks to support Ronald McDonald House.

You are invited to join us in a showcase of the Fall Journal Edition of the Word for Word Medical Humanities journal! Be the first to peruse our original artwork, interviews, opinion pieces, and more. Free pizza, sweets, and refreshments will be served. Join us at Gutmann Classroom 208 from 5:30-6pm this Saturday, 2/7. Hope to see you there ✨

THANK YOU for all of your help during our fundraiser!! Because of your efforts, over 920+ meals will be provided across the city of Philadelphia. 

We are so incredibly thankful to our contributors, and especially our partner, Philabundance, who made this work possible. Donations are still ongoing at ARCH Café, so if you have more food to donate this holiday season, check out that location!

Learn more about Philabundance’s efforts to combat food insecurity here: https://www.philabundance.org
We’re proud to partner with Philabundance to support our community. Food drive donations are being collected in the Arch Lobby! 🥫💚 See slide 3 for the photo.
